802b3e54-3c53-4b37-a089-8e97a4e163f3@ufc.why: Heavyweight headliners Waldo Cortes Acosta (#6, a power puncher trying to snap a two-fight skid) and Johnny Walker (fresh off a highlight KO at UFC 332, now testing himself at a new weight) meet in a statement fight. In the co-main, former title challengers Tatiana Suarez (#2, elite wrestler-grappler) and Virna Jandiroba (#3, submission specialist) clash with the winner expecting a shot at strawweight champ Mackenzie Dern.
802b3e54-3c53-4b37-a089-8e97a4e163f3@ufc.know: UFC rankings run from champion down to #15 per division, so a top-6 win carries real weight toward a title shot. A Fight Night card like this has no title on the line itself but often decides who earns one next. You already saw Walker finish Mick Parkin at UFC 332, so this is his first test since that breakout performance.

89e0495f-fe2d-46a6-9588-b813f1ec768e@nin.why: The 49ers are 6-1 and alone in first place in the NFC West, their only loss coming to Atlanta right before their bye week (a scheduled week off). The Raiders are 4-4, a team that opened 3-0 before losing four straight. A win keeps San Francisco rolling atop its division, but it is too early for any playoff-clinching or elimination stakes.
89e0495f-fe2d-46a6-9588-b813f1ec768e@nin.know: NFC West is one of the NFL's eight divisions; its leader gets an edge toward the playoffs later. No single November game decides a season, so watch the overall win streak and health trends. Keep an eye on running back Christian McCaffrey, working through a hamstring issue, and quarterback Brock Purdy, who is having an MVP-caliber year.
